name: BRAND TEXT
description: Cixi Shangguan Industry Co., Ltd, a new and developing manufacturer specializing in various kinds of fitness equipment, is located by the south bank of Hang Zhou Gulf Bridge, near the side of No.329 Country highway. It enjoys convenient traffic, since the factory is 25 kilometers from Ningbo downtown and 30 kilometers far from Ningbo international airport. The plant covers a floor space of 55,000 square meters with existing construction area of 20,000 square meters, under construction workshop area of 15,000 square meters.  Presently, our main products are treadmills, which can be divided into three series, different decades of kinds. Some of them are CE approved. With a team of experienced R&D staff and advanced production equipments, we can also design and manufacture according to customer designated style. OEM orders are warmly welcome.  Joining an increasingly sharp competition in world market, we gradually grow to be stronger by policy of excellent quality, competitive price, cordial service and creative development. We will continue performing and following the policy, provide our best possible services to fulfill our every customer's need. Warmly welcome the customers all over the world to contact us for more details and create the business opportunity together with us.
